rs3745274.sentence: Genotype GT of rs3745274 is associated with increased risk of tumor occurrence when treated with tacrolimus in people with kidney transplantation as compared to genotype GG (p = 0.048).
rs3745274.explanation: In a cohort of 79 adult kidney transplant recipients on tacrolimus, logistic regression showed the CYP2B6 rs3745274 GT genotype in recipients was linked to higher tumor incidence during follow-up (p = 0.048).

rs1045642.sentence: Genotype CC of rs1045642 is associated with decreased likelihood of severe infections when treated with tacrolimus in people with kidney transplantation as compared to genotypes CT + TT (OR: 0.087).
rs1045642.explanation: Logistic regression in the 79-patient tacrolimus-treated kidney transplant cohort found the recipient ABCB1 rs1045642 CC genotype had markedly lower severe infection risk (OR 0.087).

rs4244285.sentence: Genotype AA of rs4244285 is associated with increased risk of nephrotoxicity and higher dose-adjusted tacrolimus concentrations when treated with tacrolimus in people with kidney transplantation as compared to genotype GG (p = 0.026).
rs4244285.explanation: The study reported significantly increased nephrotoxicity risk (OR 11.6; p = 0.026) and elevated tacrolimus C/D among patients with CYP2C19*2 (rs4244285 AA).

rs9282564.sentence: Genotype AA of rs9282564 (donor) is associated with increased likelihood of severe infections when treated with tacrolimus in people with kidney transplantation as compared to genotypes AG + GG (OR: 23.8).
rs9282564.explanation: Donor ABCB1 rs9282564 AA showed a markedly increased severe infection risk by logistic regression in the 79-patient tacrolimus cohort; this SNP also showed survival differences by Kaplan–Meier (log-rank p = 0.042).

rs776746.sentence: Genotype GG of rs776746 (CYP3A5*3/*3) is associated with increased dose-adjusted tacrolimus concentrations in people with kidney transplantation as compared to genotypes AG + AA.
rs776746.explanation: Consistent with CPIC/DPWG guidance, the study observed higher tacrolimus C/D in CYP3A5 non-expressers (*3/*3) among the 79 recipients; survival differences by KM were not statistically significant (log-rank p = 0.138).

rs2066844.sentence: Genotype CC of rs2066844 (donor) is associated with decreased risk of nephrotoxicity when treated with tacrolimus in people with kidney transplantation as compared to genotypes CT + TT.
rs2066844.explanation: Logistic regression showed donor NOD2 rs2066844 CC reduced nephrotoxicity risk; prior literature linked this locus to hospital stay, but not tacrolimus PK.

rs2740574.explanation: The study found significantly higher tacrolimus C/D in CYP3A4 rs2740574 AA recipients (p < 0.001), aligning with previous reports of enhanced CYP3A4 activity.

rs4149056.sentence: Genotype TT of rs4149056 is associated with decreased risk of acute rejection and increased dose-adjusted tacrolimus concentrations when treated with tacrolimus in people with kidney transplantation as compared to genotypes CT + CC (OR: 0.157).
rs4149056.explanation: Recipient SLCO1B1 rs4149056 TT showed reduced acute rejection risk (OR 0.157) and higher tacrolimus C/D over time in this 79-patient cohort.
